in_marathi.name: Rithik
in_marathi.long_meaning: Rithik हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ritvik is a name derived from Sanskrit, which means 'Sun God'. It is a powerful and intelligent name that resonates with the themes of the sun, fire, and light. In Hindu mythology, Rithvik is a divine being associated with the sun and is believed to possess immense power and wisdom.
